changelog:
Rebuilt System settings into storage, backup, updates, diagnostics and maintenance.
Renewed compact native settings navigation, accessibility and search.
Overhauled layout inspection, temporary edits, undo and safe owner cleanup.
Rebuilt the debug console with live/pause, filters and full retained-log copy.
Separated manual feature review from runtime telemetry and static metadata.
Added bounded cache operations, protected imports and checked settings resets.
Fixed downloader-hook ownership and atomic settings import persistence.
Redacted input and credential patterns in diagnostic exports.
message: System, diagnostics and layout tools renewed
